snippet.title: Kloa: Child of The Forest - Release Date Trailer - | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

A mysterious curse called the Ikari is killing the forest and turning its animals into monsters, and Kloa, a human child, is the only one who can stop it. This top-down action adventure from Wildpad Games and Crytivo pairs hand-drawn pixel art with katana-and-bow combat, puzzles, and an orchestral score inspired by traditional Japanese music
